about: Sentinel and poison probes inside a condition. The GENERAL PIP subject.parityS44Sent answers ["m"] and is read at one position: an atom of AND or OR after, before or beside an atom that is true, false, ends the rule (an absent attribute) or fails the decision (subject.parityS44Failed, 404), or an operand of an operator beside an operand that has a value, is absent, null or failed. Every request records the calls of /api/v1/pip/s44-sent (pipCalls): whether the position is evaluated, and whether a value is read and dropped. Each condition is asked in the observation forms that tell its outcome apart.
